verdicts.reason: Both reduce the photo to an unreadable strip of sweater at the right edge, and the 'GIFT' and 'cup of coffee' text runs onto it, so text sits on a busy image. 'Only this Christmas' is pushed off-centre while the stars sit at the left, there is a stray line at the bottom-left, and 'next' is left alone on its own line. A spaces its dashed dividers unevenly but keeps the headline slightly clearer of the pattern. B groups the elements a bit more tightly but drops 'GIFT' right onto the red-and-white pattern, so the two are close to equal.
